import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=2, ncols=1, figsize=(10, 12))

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', multiple='stack', bins=30, palette='coolwarm', ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of transactions per transaction type and fraud status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='coolwarm', ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows=2, ncols=1, figsize=(10, 12))

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
sns.histplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', multiple='stack', bins=30, palette='coolwarm', ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Plot 2: Count of transactions per transaction type and fraud status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='coolwarm', ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count')
